[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 2 [[Feather]]s }} [[Frosted Griffon Wing]]s are the wings of [[Blessed Griffon]]s that are found in the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]]. According to [[Nicholas the Traveler]], they are often used to increase traction for walking on the slippery slopes of the mountains. == Acquisition == * [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] ** [[Southern Shiverpeaks]] *** [[Blessed Griffon]] * [[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]] ** [[Far Shiverpeaks]] *** Blessed Griffon {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== ;[[Snake Dance]] There is a large group of griffons along the southern edge, just outside of [[Camp Rankor]]. == Collectors == {{:Hagnon Warblade/Collector}} {{:Hagnon Warblade/Collector armor}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|30th November 2009 and 27th August 2012|Snake Dance|2 [[Frosted Griffon Wing]]s}} == Notes == * The collector [[Hagnon Warblade]] trades 5 Frosted Griffon Wings for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is over three times more than just selling the trophies by themselves. * Frosted Griffon Wings can also be salvaged into [[feather]]s which can be sold to [[material trader]]s for an even greater return.
